title: The Old Man and His Grandson
summary: An old grandfather could scarcely walk; his knees trembled, his eyes were dim, and his hands shook so that he spilled soup on the tablecloth....
keywords: the old man and his grandson
full_text:
An old grandfather could scarcely walk; his knees trembled, his eyes were dim, and his hands shook so that he spilled soup on the tablecloth.

Disgusted, his son and daughter-in-law made him sit in the corner behind the stove, feeding him scraps from a cheap earthenware bowl. One day, the bowl broke, and they bought him a rough wooden trough.

One afternoon, the parents saw their four-year-old son fitting little wooden boards together on the floor.

"What are you making, my child?" asked the father lovingly.

The little boy replied: "I am making a little wooden trough for you and mother to eat from when I grow up and you are old!"

The husband and wife looked at each other and burst into tears of shame. They brought the old grandfather back to the master table, ate with him in honor, and never spoke another harsh word to him again.
moral: Treat your aged parents with tender reverence, as you would have your own children treat you.

Believing rumors and flattery without proof
